title.translate: An Account That Can Be Questioned

description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper. I will write what I witnessed and mark what I do not know. Let someone question the account without having to cross the Nether to find me. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

title.translate: An Account That Can Be Questioned

description.translate: Cassian is right to send you onward. A.U.R.A. may hold the research that our retreat scattered. The End is reached through your existing progress, not through a promise I can make at this desk.
